test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The incident was narrated by somebody to Naresh.

options.text: Somebody was narrating the incident to Naresh.
Somebody narrated the incident to Naresh.
Somebody was about to narrate the incident to Naresh.
Somebody will narrate the incident to Naresh.

solution:
The correct answer is "**Somebody narrated the incident to Naresh**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There are a few things to keep in mind when changing a sentence from **passive to active voice**.

 
 
• The **agent **in the passive voice becomes the subject(doer of the action) of the active voice.
 
• In the given sentence, "**somebody**" becomes the **subject **in the active voice.
 
• We can omit the usage of "**by**" in the active voice. We use the preposition "by" to show the **agent **in the passive voice.
 
• We can also omit the usage of "to be" forms in the active voice. So we can omit "**was**" which is the past tense of "to be" in the given sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in the **simple past tense.**
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is** option 2.**

​The correct sentence is: *Somebody narrated the incident to Naresh.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__***

__
 
• वाक्य को passive to active voice में बदलते समय कुछ बातों का ध्यान रखना चाहिए।

 
 
• **passive voice** में एजेंट **active voice** का विषय (कार्रवाई का कर्ता) बन जाता है।
 
• दिए गए वाक्य में, "somebody" सक्रिय आवाज में विषय बन जाता है।
 
• हम **active voice** में "by" के उपयोग को छोड़ सकते हैं। एजेंट को **passive voice** में दिखाने के लिए हम "by" **preposition **का उपयोग करते हैं।
 
• हम active voice में **"****to be**" फॉर्म के उपयोग को भी छोड़ सकते हैं।
 
• इसलिए हम "was" को छोड़ सकते हैं जो दिए गए वाक्य में "**to be**" का भूत काल है।
 
 
 
• दिया गया वाक्य simple past tense का है।

38:Tcb8,

The correct answer is "**sensible**".
